m102-friends.observed_description: One continuous photo of a family garden party on one lawn, balloons on a long table behind: a husband and wife standing close and talking face to face on the left; an older man sitting alone on a wooden bench; a boy running across the grass with a brown dog trotting ahead of him; two girls playing with a blue hoop on the right. Nobody else.
m102-friends.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). One photograph with no seams; every group is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The two girls wear matching dresses, so the cue names the pair (the daughter and a friend) and the target covers both.
